what: FINDING_1: Step 3 summary-mode opt-in is not actionable before reviewer launch
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says Step 3 has no immediate prompt and the user must interrupt the voting kickoff, but the surrounding /design anti-halt flow immediately proceeds into review dispatch. For large plans, the user may only see an outline before reviewers are launched, which fails the visibility-critical pre-review boundary.
suggested_fix: Add an explicit pause when summary mode fires at Step 3, such as an AskUserQuestion with Continue and Show full plan, or print the full plan at Step 3 and reserve summary mode for Gate C where Other is available.

what: FINDING_2: Gate C final-plan presentation remains prose-only and duplicates the summary algorithm
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed Gate C change relies on the executor reimplementing the Step 3 summary rules from prose immediately before AskUserQuestion. A skipped print, inconsistent threshold handling, or missing Other re-prompt path would let the user approve without seeing the intended content.
suggested_fix: Introduce a small shared presenter helper or an explicit Gate C Bash block using the same implementation as Step 3, then have both sites call it with different headers and opt-in text.

what: FINDING_3: Large-plan summary assumes a first-line title and H2/H3 outline that Step 2b does not require
scenario_or_breakage: Step 2b asks for plan sections but does not require Markdown H1/H2/H3 formatting. A large plan written with bold labels or bullets can produce a non-title first line plus an empty outline, so the summary hides almost all plan content at both visibility boundaries.
suggested_fix: Either strengthen Step 2b to require and validate a heading contract, or make summary mode fall back to the first N non-empty lines or recognized section labels when no H2/H3 outline is found.

what: FINDING_4: CHANGELOG update is required later but omitted from Files to modify
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says CHANGELOG.md gets a PATCH entry for the new LARCH_DESIGN_PLAN_SUMMARY_THRESHOLD env var, while the Files to modify list and testing note say only two markdown files change. An implementer following the file list can miss the changelog and leave the env var undiscoverable.
suggested_fix: Add CHANGELOG.md to Files to modify and update the testing note to reflect three markdown files.
